title: Add an account
intro: A new login on a host, for sessions to bill. Each login has its own name on that host, so one host can hold several accounts.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Sign in with
fields.help: Setup token: a claude setup-token token, valid about a year and never revoked by another copy of the login. Best on a host nobody signs in on by hand.

fields.name: profile
fields.label: Name
fields.help: Letters, digits, _ or -. New sessions pick the account by this name. On the host it lives in ~/.claude-profiles/<name>.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.secret_note: sk-ant-…, checked with Anthropic, then written to the host only. Fleet keeps no copy.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Setup token
fields.secret_note: sk-ant-oat01-…, from claude setup-token on any machine. Written to the host only. Fleet keeps no copy.

fields.name: account
fields.label: Account
fields.help: Whose subscription the token is. Anthropic does not say, so pick it: sessions under the token then count against that account's limits.

fields.name: daily_limit
fields.label: Daily limit (USD)
fields.help: Empty: no limit. Past it, no session starts on this account until midnight UTC.
